statement:
∀ (phi : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ phi (closedBall c ρ) →
      ∀ (m : ℕ), residue (fun z => phi z / (z - c) ^ (m + 1)) c ρ = iteratedDeriv m phi c / ↑m !

goal.text: residue (fun z => phi z / (z - c) ^ (m + 1)) c ρ = iteratedDeriv m phi c / ↑m !
goal.lhs: residue (fun z => phi z / (z - c) ^ (m + 1)) c ρ

atoms: residue (fun z => phi z / (z - c) ^ (m + 1)) c ρ
